component.name: NASync
component.summary: Sync your folders to a home NAS

description.p: NASync keeps folders on your computer in step with a SAMBA/SMB share on a home NAS. It speaks SMB 2/3 directly, so there is nothing to install on the server and no external tooling on this side either.
Each server you add is configured on its own terms:

ul.li: A sync root — one folder on the share NASync may touch. Everything else on that share is out of reach, so a video or a photo library sitting beside the root cannot be deleted whatever you sync later.
A sync mode. Mirror makes the server match your folders exactly, deleting what you removed locally; Update only ever adds. Restoring never deletes local files in either mode.
Automatic syncing — moments after a file changes, once a day at a time you pick, or both. Live sync runs only while you are on the server's network, so a laptop away from home waits and catches up.

description.p: Saved NAS passwords are encrypted with a key held for the app by the desktop's secret portal, never written alongside the settings.

description.p: Adds a sync root per server, so everything beside it on the share is unreachable rather than merely untargeted. Fixes notifications not appearing on GNOME 50, a copy producing one notification per file, and mirror mode leaving empty folders behind.
